labour.loadingIncluded: Fully-loaded hourly cost INCLUDES: everything Eurostat counts as labour cost in manufacturing — wages and salaries, bonuses, paid leave and public holidays, employer social contributions, vocational training and other labour taxes, less subsidies — per hour ACTUALLY WORKED (2025, carried to 2026 by the labour cost index); the role's level is its ISCO major group's mean hourly earnings relative to all occupations in manufacturing (SES 2022)
labour.loadingNotIncluded: NOT included: a 3-shift premium beyond what the average manufacturing employee is paid (the average already holds the shift allowances actually paid); overtime; agency margins; work clothing and training time outside the survey
labour.short: Eurostat manufacturing labour cost per hour worked 2025 × LCI × SES occupation ratio
